original_title: Elden Ring Director Insists FromSoftware Is Free to Make the Games It Wants To, Teases 'Unannounced Titles'

en.title: FromSoftware Freedom: Miyazaki Reassures Fans Amidst Kadokawa Shareholder Scrutiny
en.summary: Despite recent news surrounding its parent company Kadokawa and activist investor pressure, FromSoftware's Hidetaka Miyazaki insists the studio remains free to pursue its creative vision. This reassurance comes as fans speculate about the future of iconic franchises and upcoming projects.
en.body:
The halls of FromSoftware, the acclaimed studio behind **Elden Ring** and the **Dark Souls** series, have been filled with more than just the whispers of ambitious game development lately. News has surfaced regarding significant shareholder activity impacting its parent company, Kadokawa Corporation, sparking concern among its dedicated fanbase. However, visionary director **Hidetaka Miyazaki** has stepped forward to quell these anxieties, asserting that the studio's creative freedom remains paramount.

Activist investor firm Oasis Management Company has steadily increased its stake in Kadokawa, now holding the largest share at 13.76%, surpassing even Sony's 11.01%. This move has led to calls for changes within Kadokawa's leadership and raised questions about the future direction of its most valuable asset: FromSoftware. Oasis has previously expressed a desire for Kadokawa to better capitalize on FromSoftware's immense success, suggesting a potential shift in strategy that could impact the types of games the studio is able to produce.

> "We can freely make the kind of games we want to make without excessive interference." — Hidetaka Miyazaki

This statement from **Miyazaki** is a crucial reassurance for players who have come to expect FromSoftware's unique brand of challenging, atmospheric, and deeply rewarding experiences. The studio has a proven track record of pushing boundaries, from the intricate world-building of **Elden Ring** to the punishing yet fair combat of **Dark Souls**. The prospect of external pressures dictating creative choices is a worrying one for a community that cherishes the distinct identity of these titles.

## Fan Concerns and Future Hopes

For many, FromSoftware represents a bastion of originality in an industry sometimes perceived as overly reliant on sequels and safe bets. The worry is that a focus on maximizing shareholder returns could lead to a dilution of the studio's signature style, perhaps pushing for more mainstream-friendly mechanics or a faster release cadence that sacrifices polish and innovation. The mention of an "unannounced title" set for a 2026 release, alongside the confirmed multiplayer-focused game **The Duskbloods**, offers a glimmer of hope that the studio is indeed continuing to explore new horizons, but the specifics remain a tantalizing mystery.

## What's Next

While **Miyazaki**'s words provide a significant dose of comfort, the ongoing developments at Kadokawa will undoubtedly be monitored closely by fans worldwide. The studio's commitment to its unique development philosophy will be tested, but for now, the focus remains on the unannounced projects and the potential for further groundbreaking titles that have become synonymous with the FromSoftware name.

tr.title: FromSoftware Özgürlüğü: Miyazaki, Kadokawa Pay Sahibi İncelemesi Ortaklığına Karşı Tüketicileri Rahatlattı
tr.summary: FromSoftware'un yaratıcı vizyonu özgür kalmaya devam ettiğini iddia eden stüdyonun CEO'su Hidetaka Miyazaki, Kadokawa'nın pay sahipleri tarafından yapılan eleştirilere karşı bir mesaj verdi. Miyazaki'nin açıklaması, stüdyonun gelecekteki projeleri ve ikonik franchise'lerin geleceği hakkında endişeleri azalttı.
tr.body:
FromSoftware, **Elden Ring** ve **Dark Souls** serisinin yaratıcısı olarak bilinen stüdyonun salonları, son zamanlarda sadece yeni oyun geliştirme projeleri hakkında konuşuluyordu. Ancak Kadokawa Corporation'un pay sahipleri ile ilgili yeni haberler, stüdyonun fan tabanında endişelere yol açtı. Ancak stüdyonun CEO'su Hidetaka Miyazaki, bu endişeleri azaltmak için bir açıklama yaptı.

Miyazaki, stüdyonun yaratıcı özgürlüğü konusunda endişe duyduğunu söyledi ve stüdyonun, aşırı müdahale olmadan, istediği gibi oyunlar yapabildiğini belirtti.

"We can freely make the kind of games we want to make without excessive interference." — Hidetaka Miyazaki

Bu açıklama, **Elden Ring** ve **Dark Souls** gibi zor, atmosferik ve derinlemesine keyifli oyunlar yaratma konusunda stüdyonun bilinen tarzını koruduğunu belirten oyuncular için büyük bir rahatlama oldu. Stüdyonun, **Elden Ring**'in karmaşık dünyası ile **Dark Souls**'un cezbedici ama adil dövüş mekanizması gibi oyunlar yaratma konusunda bir geçmişe sahip.

## Oyuncuların Sorunları ve Gelecek Umutları

Manyaklar için FromSoftware, orijinalite konusunda bir sığınak olarak görülüyor. Stüdyonun, pay sahiplerinin beklentilerini karşılamak için oyunlarını daha ana akım friendly yapması veya daha hızlı bir şekilde oyunlarını yayınlaması gibi endişeler var. Stüdyonun, 2026'da yayınlanması planlanan bir oyun ile birlikte, **The Duskbloods** gibi multiplayer odaklı bir oyun geliştirdiği açıklaması, stüdyonun yeni yollar açmaya devam ettiğini gösteriyor.

## Gelecek

Miyazaki'nin açıklaması, oyuncuların endişelerini azalttı. Ancak Kadokawa'nın devam eden gelişimleri, dünya çapında oyuncular tarafından yakından takip edilecek. Stüdyonun, yaratıcı vizyonuna bağlı kalma konusundaki kararlılığı, gelecekteki projeleri ve ikonik franchise'lerin geleceği hakkında endişeleri azalttı.

es.title: La Libertad de FromSoftware: Miyazaki Alivia Temores
es.summary: A pesar de las noticias recientes sobre su empresa matriz Kadokawa y la presión de los inversores, el director Hidetaka Miyazaki asegura que FromSoftware sigue siendo libre para perseguir su visión creativa. Esta garantía llega en un momento en que los fanáticos especulan sobre el futuro de franquicias icónicas y proyectos futuros.
es.body:
Las salas de FromSoftware, la aclamada estudio detrás de **Elden Ring** y la serie **Dark Souls**, han estado llenas de más que solo los murmullos de desarrollo de juegos ambiciosos en reciente tiempo. Se ha surgido noticias sobre la actividad significativa de los accionistas que impacta a su empresa matriz, Kadokawa Corporation, lo que ha levantado preocupaciones entre su fanbase dedicado. Sin embargo, el director visionario **Hidetaka Miyazaki** ha salido a adelantar estas inquietudes, asegurando que la libertad creativa del estudio sigue siendo la prioridad.

La firma de inversores activos Oasis Management Company ha aumentado gradualmente su participación en Kadokawa, ahora con la mayor participación del 13,76%, superando incluso la de Sony con el 11,01%. Esto ha llevado a llamados a cambios dentro de la dirección de Kadokawa y ha levantado preguntas sobre la dirección futura de su activo más valioso: FromSoftware. Oasis ha expresado anteriormente su deseo de que Kadokawa aproveche mejor el éxito inmenso de FromSoftware, sugiriendo un posible cambio de estrategia que podría impactar en los tipos de juegos que el estudio es capaz de producir.

> "Podemos hacer los juegos que queremos hacer sin interferencia excesiva." — Hidetaka Miyazaki

Esta declaración de **Miyazaki** es una garantía crucial para los jugadores que han llegado a esperar la marca única de FromSoftware de experiencias desafiantes, atmosféricas y profundamente gratificantes. El estudio tiene un historial probado de empujar límites, desde la construcción del mundo intrincada de **Elden Ring** hasta el combate punzante pero justo de **Dark Souls**. La perspectiva de presiones externas dictando elecciones creativas es un miedo preocupante para una comunidad que valora la identidad distintiva de estos títulos.

## Preocupaciones de los fanáticos y esperanzas futuras

Para muchos, FromSoftware representa un baluarte de originalidad en una industria a veces percibida como demasiado dependiente de secuelas y apuestas seguras. El miedo es que un enfoque en maximizar las ganancias de los accionistas podría llevar a una dilución del estilo distintivo del estudio, quizás empujando hacia mecánicas más amigables para el mainstream o un ritmo de lanzamiento más rápido que sacrifica la pulcritud y la innovación. La mención de un "título no anunciado" programado para su lanzamiento en 2026, junto con el juego enfocado en multijugador **The Duskbloods**, ofrece una luz de esperanza de que el estudio sigue explorando nuevos horizontes, pero los detalles siguen siendo un misterio atractivo.

## Próximos Pasos

Si bien las palabras de **Miyazaki** brindan una dosis significativa de consuelo, los desarrollos en curso en Kadokawa seguirán siendo monitoreados con atención por los fanáticos en todo el mundo. La compromiso del estudio con su filosofía de desarrollo único será probado, pero por ahora, el enfoque sigue siendo en los proyectos no anunciados y la potencialidad de futuros títulos innovadores que se han vuelto sinónimos con el nombre de FromSoftware.

content_raw: Dark Souls and Elden Ring creator Hidetaka Miyazaki recently commented on the shareholder pressure that is putting FromSoftware parent company Kadokawa in the news lately. Reassuring fans, he insisted that Fromsoftware can still “freely make the kind of games we want to make without excessive interference." Kadokawa has been in the news in Japan lately, as an activist investment firm has gradually acquired the largest stake in the Japanese multimedia conglomerate. As previously reported by IGN back in March, Oasis Management Company is a major activist investor in Kadokawa that has raised its stake to 13.76%, according to Kadokawa’s latest AGM announcement . For context, this even beats out second biggest shareholder Sony’s 11.01% stake. Not to be confused with political activism, an activist investor is an individual or company that aims to purchase a significant minority stake in other companies so that they can influence how they are operated or managed, usually with the aim of boosting shareholder returns. On its website A Better Kadokawa , Oasis recognizes the huge financial success that FromSoftware has brought Kadokawa with its acclaimed series like Armored Core and Dark Souls and, of course, Elden Ring. However, it claimed that “Kadokawa fails to capture FromSoftware’s full value, ceding economics to external partners.” This has got Dark Souls and Elden Ring fans worried about how Oasis may impact future FromSoftware titles. After all, this is the same Oasis that back in 2014 tried to persuade Nintendo to move towards mobile games, saying, “Just think of paying 99 cents just to get Mario to jump a little higher.” Oasis has already called for the removal of current Kadokawa CEO Takeshi Natsuno (for company financial performance reasons). Kadokawa announced on June 3 that it will oppose the proposal to dismiss Natsuno at its upcoming annual shareholders meeting on June 24. If a new CEO were in place at Kadokawa, could they force FromSoftware to make different kinds of games, cash in on its franchises in some way, or perhaps force the developer to release new games more frequently? Denfaminico Gamer reached out to Dark Souls and Elden Ring creator Hidetaka Miyazaki to get his take on the situation as a developer at FromSoftware. In his emailed response, Miyazaki stated that although he is aware of what has been reported in the media regarding Oasis and Kadokawa’s situation, he was unable to address the matter in depth. Miyazaki said that overall, he is satisfied with the creative environment at FromSoftware. “I’m not saying that there’s no room for improvement but we can freely make the kind of games we want to make without excessive interference." “I think for both myself and for FromSoftware, the most important thing going forward is to maintain this environment and focus as much as possible on game development,” Miyazaki continued.
